newsitem.title: USA: US Treasury 5-yr note yld seen at 5.97 pct at sale.
newsitem.headline: US Treasury 5-yr note yld seen at 5.97 pct at sale.

text.p: The U.S. Treasury's auction of $12.50 billion in five-year notes on Wednesday is expected to produce a yield between 5.97 and 5.98 percent, dealers said.

At 1230 EST/1730 GMT, the five-year notes were quoted at 5.96 percent in when-issued trade. Demand for the securities appears very strong, traders said. And GovPX noted that volume for the notes was higher this session than on a typical five-year note auction day.
The bidding deadline for the notes is 1300 EST/1800 GMT and results are expected around 1345 EST/1845 GMT.
